evidence_level: Audited per-pattern means and success counts over 20 trials; not individual seed records.

protocol.question: Preservation of the visible layout observations behind the Table 1 fixes, plus the rare optimized InlineSkipList mixture
protocol.pairing: Same page sample and one history/per-time clustering pair for all eight method/budget combinations
protocol.backend_clock: Each sample uses the existing backend's own event endpoints for per-time fingerprints and object endpoints for display-history reduction. Do not replace these silently with full-trace endpoints.
protocol.reference: Complete input database before initial page sampling or display-history reduction. Identical full-input reference for every seed, sampling setting and arm.
protocol.grid: The fixed grid spans the complete input's execution timestamps for every arm. It is a common evaluation grid, not a claim that every sample's default GUI slider has identical endpoints.
protocol.truth_guard: Intersect displayed pattern intervals with full-reference intervals on the same page before counting success. Simultaneous occurrences on several pages count once.
protocol.bccosparse: Keep existing thresholds: positive index-node union bytes at most one eighth of a 2 MiB page; total occupied union bytes at least one quarter; non-node union bytes at least node union bytes. Count byte unions, not allocation-size sums. Node and non-node occupied extents must be disjoint, so enclosing buffers cannot manufacture the pattern.
protocol.bccomutex: At least one complete live 40-byte pthread_mutex_t allocated at the verified Row_lock site (file 16, line 25). This preserves the separately allocated mutex evidence, not pointer ownership or measured contention.
protocol.valkey: At least one complete live crossing 40-byte robj at the patched site (file 11, object.c line 75). No radix-node claim or eight-object density requirement.
protocol.global_factors: TPC-C/EFRB reclamation-block buildup is checked through globally preserved LINES/STATS data, not a page-local proxy. HNSW vector alignment is page-visible; physical huge-page backing is a separate performance factor, not inferable from these virtual-address traces.
protocol.absence: An absent full-input target is reported as absent, never a preservation failure and never grounds to retune the predicate or choose another capture.
protocol.concurrency: Ready applications run independently; 48 hardware threads on node0; memory may span NUMA nodes
protocol.duration_coverage: Full-input union denominator once per input; computed independently
